titre.en: science topics that sound fake but are real

legendes.en:
every single one of these sounds made up. every single one is real.

chemistry that looks like magic, planets that shouldn't exist, living things that ignore the rules, earth doing weird stuff, and math that feels illegal.

pick the one u don't believe and look it up.

save this for ur next science rabbit hole.

#whattolearnwhenbored #selfimprovement #learning #curiosity #studytok

paragraphes: Sophia gives me one lesson a day, written by actual professors, with a little quiz after. history, philosophy, science, geopolitics, literature, economics.
it's 10 minutes, and it's how i learned that half the stuff i thought was fake is actually real.

en.texte: save this and send it to the friend who says science is boring. pick one topic and prove them wrong.
en.gras: OR.. keep thinking it's all made up.
